articles.title: Chinese Hackers Upgrade EggStreme Malware With Silent Backdoor to Evade Security Detection
articles.summary:
A suspected Chinese cyberespionage group has rebuilt its EggStreme malware framework, adding a Windows backdoor that waits for an incoming connection instead of calling out to an attacker-controlled server. Bitdefender’s November 18, 2026, report tracks the changes as the group continues to target government organizations in the Philippines. Researchers also found signs of possible targeting […]

articles.title: AuditTeam Ransomware Gang Poses as Security Auditors and Use AV Drivers to Kill EDR Process
articles.summary:

It asks for an “Audit & Consulting fee” in return for a report on the holes the attackers used to get in. Before the note appears, the group has already […]

articles.title: Hackers Actively Exploit Critical Apache Roller RCE Flaw to Execute Code Without Authentication
articles.summary:
Hackers are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in Apache Roller that lets them run code on affected servers without signing in, the Apache Software Foundation warned on November 17. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-129448, affects versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 and carries a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.8 out of 10. Apache says administrators should upgrade […]
